hooks.title: The Closed Border
hooks.text: By order of Hierarch Thysil, no wagon may cross into Trynkyrgydnyr. The merchants of Svaiyimoth are quietly paying anyone who can get their goods through regardless.

hooks.title: Opened Graves
hooks.text: Old graves from the Thistle Pox have been opened in the night. The folk of Svaiyimlal whisper that someone wants the sickness back.

hooks.title: The Tax Strike
hooks.text: Hierarch Thysil takes 14 in every hundred on trade, about 30757 sp a year, and the towns grumble. A pamphleteer calling for a tax strike must be found, or protected, depending on who pays.

hooks.title: Treasure-Hunters
hooks.text: Treasure-hunters are digging at Glafimere, near Svaiyimoth. Hierarch Thysil wants them stopped, or wants a share.

hooks.title: Gifts from Taifithlal
hooks.text: Hierarch Glandil the Just has sent gifts to Svaiyimoth. Hierarch Thysil's counsellors cannot agree whether they are a courtship or a bribe.

reasons: About 36,383 sp of goods pass between them each year.
They have fought two wars in recorded memory.
Four settlements changed hands between them by the sword.
Their peoples share a tongue and customs.
About 14,891 sp of goods pass between them each year.
They have fought four wars in recorded memory.
One settlement changed hands between them by the sword.
The last war between them ended only 36 years ago.

events.title: The founding of Svaiyimlal
events.text: Wearied of paying tribute to everyone, 0 settlements around Svaiyimoth agree to answer to one table, and call it Svaiyimlal.

events.title: Svaiyimlal begins under House Labrook
events.text: House Labrook takes the lordship of Svaiyimlal at its founding.

events.title: Hierarch Randas of Svaiyimlal
events.text: With the old ruler's seal on a ribbon around the neck, Randas of House Labrook becomes Hierarch of Svaiyimlal.

events.title: A vote at Svaiyimoth
events.text: The electors of Svaiyimlal raise House Rieleaf to rule.
events.name: The Raising of House Rieleaf
events.backstory: The custom of Svaiyimlal is to choose its rulers, and in 49 the electors passed over Labrook for House Rieleaf.

events.title: Hierarch Fision of Svaiyimlal
events.text: Fision of House Rieleaf is raised as Hierarch of Svaiyimlal.

events.title: The Ryrern War
events.text: Old grievances at Ryrern set Svaiyimlal and Trynkyrgydnyr at each other's throats.
events.name: The Ryrern War
events.backstory: Svaiyimlal raised the toll on Ryrern bridge, Trynkyrgydnyr refused to pay, and the Ryrern War was the result.

events.title: The Treaty of Ryrern
events.text: After years of burnt barns and empty cradles, Svaiyimlal and Trynkyrgydnyr agree that nothing was worth it, and change no boundary.

events.title: High water at Klomokro
events.text: The river lifts over its banks, and Klomokro stand in brown water.
events.backstory: A bank of the Meglibrook gave way in 71 above Klomokro, and the water had nowhere else to go.

events.title: The electors of Svaiyimlal choose
events.text: With no clear heir, the notables of Svaiyimlal vote, and House Vianawood wins by a handful of voices.
events.name: The Raising of House Vianawood
events.backstory: In 75 a vote at Svaiyimoth ended the rule of Rieleaf, and House Vianawood has held Svaiyimlal since.

events.title: Hierarch Thielas of Svaiyimlal
events.text: Thielas takes the seat of Svaiyimlal.

events.title: Glafimere is abandoned
events.text: Raiders return to Glafimere each autumn until the cottar row has nothing worth the trouble.

events.title: Nenmak in flames
events.text: A fire in the lower lanes burns a third of Nenmak.
events.name: The Burning Night of Nenmak
events.backstory: The blaze began with a forgotten lamp in a chandler's loft; by morning Nenmak was ash.

events.title: Hierarch Siathiel of Svaiyimlal
events.text: With the old ruler's seal on a ribbon around the neck, Siathiel of House Vianawood becomes Hierarch of Svaiyimlal.

events.title: The Dijilid Quarrel
events.text: Raiding and reprisals around Dijilid turn into open war between Svaiyimlal and Trynkyrgydnyr.
events.name: The Dijilid Quarrel
events.backstory: Merchants complained of bribes and double charges at Dijilid until Svaiyimlal and Trynkyrgydnyr chose swords over ledgers.

events.title: The great flood at Sefeathf
events.text: In the night the river changes its bed, taking mills, byres and cellars at Sefeathf.
events.backstory: A warm wind in 114 melted the winter snow in a week, and the Meglibrook filled faster than any dyke could be raised.

events.title: Raiders at Vysaholm
events.text: Tired of being robbed, the folk of the ferry village at Vysaholm walk the road to Mydgorn and take what they can carry.

events.title: The Peace of Dijilid
events.text: Neither side can claim victory; Svaiyimlal and Trynkyrgydnyr swap hostages and go home.

events.title: High water at Rydyl
events.text: In the night the river changes its bed, taking mills, byres and cellars at Rydyl.
events.backstory: Heavy rain upstream pushed the Meglibrook over its banks in 123, and Rydyl was caught asleep.

events.title: Teivik is abandoned
events.text: No one at Teivik can dig deeper, so the charcoal-burners' camp is left to the crows.

events.title: Baley is abandoned
events.text: Raiders strike Baley twice in a year; the survivors take refuge in Ofeibor.

events.title: The great flood at Dimo
events.text: The river lifts over its banks, and Dimo stand in brown water.
events.backstory: A bank of the Meglibrook gave way in 134 above Dimo, and the water had nowhere else to go.

events.title: Hierarch Thysylith the Hard of Svaiyimlal
events.text: Thysylith the Hard of House Vianawood is raised as Hierarch of Svaiyimlal.

events.title: Beabury given up to the raiders
events.text: Raiders strike Beabury twice in a year; the survivors take refuge in Wotmo.

events.title: Raiders at Ruthorpe
events.text: Ruthorpe is attacked in the dark twice in a year, and the charcoal-burners' camp is then left to the owls.

events.title: The Hard Summer at Obogoylt
events.text: Taifithlal marches on Obogoylt, and Svaiyimlal answers in kind; neither will name the first blow.
events.name: The Hard Summer at Obogoylt
events.backstory: It began as an argument over tolls at Obogoylt, and by 143 both Taifithlal and Svaiyimlal had armies in the field.

events.title: The Truce at Obogoylt
events.text: Taifithlal has the better of it, and Svaiyimlal gives up Obogoylt and Lenelo.

events.title: Obogoylt passes to Taifithlal
events.text: By the terms of the peace, Obogoylt owes its tithes to Taifithlal from the next harvest.
events.backstory: Obogoylt was one of the spoils of the Hard Summer at Obogoylt, and changed hands in 147 without a single arrow.

events.title: Lenelo passes to Taifithlal
events.text: Lenelo is handed from Svaiyimlal to Taifithlal.
events.backstory: Taifithlal claimed Lenelo as the price of the Hard Summer at Obogoylt, and Svaiyimlal was in no position to refuse.

events.title: Hierarch Liera of Svaiyimlal
events.text: With the old ruler's seal on a ribbon around the neck, Liera of House Vianawood becomes Hierarch of Svaiyimlal.

events.title: High water at Schilhyghyl
events.text: The river lifts over its banks, and Schilhyghyl stand in brown water.
events.name: The Great Meglibrook Spate
events.backstory: Late snows and a sudden thaw sent the Meglibrook through Schilhyghyl in 176.

events.title: The Long Raid on Rinyek
events.text: Taifithlal marches on Rinyek, and Svaiyimlal answers in kind; neither will name the first blow.
events.name: The Long Raid on Rinyek
events.backstory: Merchants complained of bribes and double charges at Rinyek until Taifithlal and Svaiyimlal chose swords over ledgers.

events.title: The Rynet flood
events.text: The river lifts over its banks, and Rynet stand in brown water.
events.backstory: Heavy rain upstream pushed the Meglibrook over its banks in 180, and Rynet was caught asleep.

events.title: Teiwick cleared by its lord
events.text: The lord clears Teiwick for sheep, and its tenants are turned out onto the road.

events.title: The Truce at Rinyek
events.text: Taifithlal kneels, in the way such things are done, and Svaiyimlal rides home with Rinyek and Obolo.

events.title: The new border at Rinyek
events.text: Rinyek is handed from Taifithlal to Svaiyimlal.
events.backstory: Rinyek was one of the spoils of the Long Raid on Rinyek, and changed hands in 191 without a single arrow.

events.title: Obolo passes to Svaiyimlal
events.text: Obolo is handed from Taifithlal to Svaiyimlal.
events.backstory: After the Long Raid on Rinyek, the people of Obolo found their new lords had little interest in their old customs.

events.title: High water at Melo
events.text: The river lifts over its banks, and Obolo and Melo stand in brown water.
events.name: The Meglibrook Rising of 191
events.backstory: Heavy rain upstream pushed the Meglibrook over its banks in 191, and Melo was caught asleep.

events.title: The Pale Shiver at Neren
events.text: It breaks out in Neren and spreads to Iclysryl, Daikelo, Vihdyl and 98 other places.
events.name: The Pale Shiver
events.backstory: When the Pale Shiver reached Neren, the people were still lean from the Black Granary Winters, and it killed them in droves.

events.title: The sickness empties Skibraby
events.text: The last families leave Skibraby after the sickness, and the hamlet falls to nettles.
events.backstory: Survivors of the Pale Shiver refused to remain at Skibraby, and the hamlet was left to the weeds in 194.

events.title: The electors of Svaiyimlal choose
events.text: With no clear heir, the notables of Svaiyimlal vote, and House Miathorn wins by a handful of voices.
events.name: The Choosing of 196
events.backstory: Vianawood ruled until 196, when the assembly of Svaiyimlal gave the office to House Miathorn.

events.title: Hierarch Glyra of Svaiyimlal
events.text: With the old ruler's seal on a ribbon around the neck, Glyra of House Miathorn becomes Hierarch of Svaiyimlal.

events.title: Muley is abandoned
events.text: The last families leave Muley after the sickness, and the shepherds' steading falls to nettles.
events.backstory: The sickness of the Pale Shiver reached Muley; by 196 the shepherds' steading was empty.

events.title: The great flood at Ofrolm
events.text: In the night the river changes its bed, taking mills, byres and cellars at Ofrolm.
events.backstory: A bank of the Meglibrook gave way in 200 above Ofrolm, and the water had nowhere else to go.

events.title: The Ghehlyc flood
events.text: Water runs through the streets of Ghehlyc and down into the cellars.
events.backstory: A warm wind in 202 melted the winter snow in a week, and the Meglibrook filled faster than any dyke could be raised.

events.title: High water at Hirjiclyr
events.text: Water runs through the streets of Rynet and Hirjiclyr and down into the cellars.
events.backstory: A bank of the Meglibrook gave way in 202 above Hirjiclyr, and the water had nowhere else to go.

events.title: The Kinbolmeibor flood
events.text: The river lifts over its banks, and Kinbolmeibor stand in brown water.
events.backstory: A warm wind in 203 melted the winter snow in a week, and the Meglibrook filled faster than any dyke could be raised.

events.title: High water at Ghigtil
events.text: In the night the river changes its bed, taking mills, byres and cellars at Ghigtil.
events.backstory: The Meglibrook rose a fathom in a night in 205, and Ghigtil had no time to carry its goods up the hill.

events.title: High water at Esidnen
events.text: The river lifts over its banks, and Esidnen stand in brown water.
events.name: The Great Meglibrook Spate of 209
events.backstory: The deep drifts in the hills melted at once, and the Meglibrook carried the whole winter down on Esidnen.

events.title: The great flood at Nofrolm
events.text: The river lifts over its banks, and Nofrolm stand in brown water.
events.backstory: The Meglibrook rose a fathom in a night in 211, and Nofrolm had no time to carry its goods up the hill.

events.title: Silt over Meibrahavn
events.text: The flood leaves Meibrahavn under silt; nobody rebuilds the farmstead.
events.backstory: The Great Meglibrook Spate of 209 left Meibrahavn a swamp, and the farmstead was abandoned in 211.

events.title: House Faleaf seizes Svaiyimlal
events.text: House Faleaf takes the high seat at Svaiyimoth while the old ruling line is away, and the gates are shut behind them.
events.name: The Night of Knives at Svaiyimoth
events.backstory: House Faleaf promised a better rule than Miathorn; it took the throne first, and made the promises afterwards.

events.title: Hierarch Glaethar of Svaiyimlal
events.text: Glaethar takes the seat of Svaiyimlal.

events.title: The Dimo flood
events.text: Water runs through the streets of Dimo and Thuteeveamsea and down into the cellars.
events.backstory: The deep drifts in the hills melted at once, and the Meglibrook carried the whole winter down on Dimo.

events.title: Raiders at Faiford
events.text: Raiders return to Faiford each autumn until the mill hamlet has nothing worth the trouble.

events.title: Bryholm is abandoned
events.text: Bryholm is attacked in the dark twice in a year, and the market village is then left to the owls.

events.title: The old line of Svaiyimlal ends
events.text: House Sybrook has the nearest claim on the vacant crown of Svaiyimlal, and nobody is in a position to dispute it.
events.name: The Failing of the Old Line
events.backstory: Faleaf died out in 221, and the lords of Svaiyimlal looked for the nearest kin they could find.

events.title: Hierarch Fysiel of Svaiyimlal
events.text: Fysiel takes the seat of Svaiyimlal.

events.title: The Deshkyrt War
events.text: Old grievances at Deshkyrt set Svaiyimlal and Trynkyrgydnyr at each other's throats.
events.name: The Deshkyrt War
events.backstory: It began as an argument over tolls at Deshkyrt, and by 222 both Svaiyimlal and Trynkyrgydnyr had armies in the field.

events.title: The Peace of Deshkyrt
events.text: Neither side can claim victory; Svaiyimlal and Trynkyrgydnyr swap hostages and go home.

events.title: The Fynemeor flood
events.text: Water runs through the streets of Fynemeor and Relo and down into the cellars.
events.backstory: A bank of the Meglibrook gave way in 231 above Fynemeor, and the water had nowhere else to go.

events.title: The Hegchen flood
events.text: Water runs through the streets of Hegchen and down into the cellars.
events.backstory: Late snows and a sudden thaw sent the Meglibrook through Hegchen in 231.

events.title: Stebury is abandoned
events.text: Raiders return to Stebury each autumn until the ferry village has nothing worth the trouble.

events.title: The Vilnen flood
events.text: Water runs through the streets of Sidkesk and Vilnen and down into the cellars.
events.backstory: A warm wind in 240 melted the winter snow in a week, and the Meglibrook filled faster than any dyke could be raised.

events.title: The dry well of Staley
events.text: The well at Staley fails in a dry summer, and the charcoal-burners' camp is left to the crows.

events.title: The great flood at Hlirgisnuk
events.text: In the night the river changes its bed, taking mills, byres and cellars at Hlirgisnuk.
events.backstory: The deep drifts in the hills melted at once, and the Meglibrook carried the whole winter down on Hlirgisnuk.

events.title: The Rust Flux
events.text: Carried along the roads from Siflel, it empties houses in Rygnichgorn, Yknik, Frirgorn and 178 other places.
events.name: The Rust Flux
events.backstory: It was the water, most agreed: after the flood of 247, the cisterns at Siflel went bad, and the Rust Flux came out of them.

events.title: The sickness empties Mymawood
events.text: No one will touch the doors of Mymawood after the fever, and the village slowly returns to the wild.
events.backstory: The sickness of the Rust Flux reached Mymawood; by 248 the village was empty.

events.title: Laesteiby is abandoned
events.text: The last families leave Laesteiby after the sickness, and the hunters' lodge falls to nettles.
events.backstory: The Rust Flux emptied Laesteiby, and the hunters' lodge was abandoned in 248.

events.title: Loawick is abandoned
events.text: The last families leave Loawick after the sickness, and the salt-works village falls to nettles.
events.backstory: The Rust Flux emptied Loawick, and the salt-works village was abandoned in 249.

events.title: The sickness empties Haiwick
events.text: Whole families die at Haiwick, and the few who live join kin at Belfekrym.
events.backstory: Survivors of the Rust Flux refused to remain at Haiwick, and the farmstead was left to the weeds in 249.

events.title: Elaewood is abandoned
events.text: The last families leave Elaewood after the sickness, and the shepherds' steading falls to nettles.
events.backstory: The sickness of the Rust Flux reached Elaewood; by 251 the shepherds' steading was empty.

events.title: Oathbreakers on the throne of Svaiyimlal
events.text: Blades are drawn in the hall at Svaiyimoth; by morning House Riabrook holds Svaiyimlal.
events.name: The Oathbreaking of 253
events.backstory: Those who served Sybrook were given a choice that night in 253, and most chose to live.

events.title: Hierarch Vaglaesar the Patient of Svaiyimlal
events.text: Vaglaesar the Patient of House Riabrook is raised as Hierarch of Svaiyimlal.

events.title: The Long Raid on Schilneted
events.text: Old grievances at Schilneted set Svaiyimlal and Trynkyrgydnyr at each other's throats.
events.name: The Long Raid on Schilneted
events.backstory: Merchants complained of bribes and double charges at Schilneted until Svaiyimlal and Trynkyrgydnyr chose swords over ledgers.

events.title: The Treaty of Schilneted
events.text: The war ends with Trynkyrgydnyr's banners over Schilneted; Svaiyimlal signs to keep the rest.

events.title: Schilneted passes to Trynkyrgydnyr
events.text: The folk of Schilneted wake to find themselves subjects of Trynkyrgydnyr.
events.backstory: Schilneted was one of the spoils of the Long Raid on Schilneted, and changed hands in 257 without a single arrow.

events.title: The Teafethd flood
events.text: In the night the river changes its bed, taking mills, byres and cellars at Flamothd and Teafethd.
events.backstory: A warm wind in 259 melted the winter snow in a week, and the Meglibrook filled faster than any dyke could be raised.

events.title: The great flood at Rycryr
events.text: Water runs through the streets of Ghehlyc and Rycryr and down into the cellars.
events.backstory: Heavy rain upstream pushed the Meglibrook over its banks in 262, and Rycryr was caught asleep.

events.title: High water at Relo
events.text: Water runs through the streets of Fynemeor and Relo and down into the cellars.
events.name: The Flood of the Broken Banks of 268
events.backstory: Late snows and a sudden thaw sent the Meglibrook through Relo in 268.

events.title: The Thistle Pox
events.text: First seen at Neflel, the sickness follows carters and pilgrims to Ildeflel, Vilend, Sedgor and 134 other places.
events.name: The Thistle Pox
events.backstory: It was the water, most agreed: after the flood of 269, the cisterns at Neflel went bad, and the Thistle Pox came out of them.

events.title: The sickness empties Fewick
events.text: Whole families die at Fewick, and the few who live join kin at Sidkesk.
events.backstory: Survivors of the Thistle Pox refused to remain at Fewick, and the mill hamlet was left to the weeds in 270.

events.title: Naiholm is abandoned
events.text: A new boundary ditch cuts Naiholm off from its common, and the hunters' lodge fades into the pasture.

events.title: The sickness empties Kecoaford
events.text: The last families leave Kecoaford after the sickness, and the farmstead falls to nettles.
events.backstory: The sickness of the Thistle Pox reached Kecoaford; by 271 the farmstead was empty.

events.title: Silence at Heaseholm
events.text: No one will touch the doors of Heaseholm after the fever, and the salt-works village slowly returns to the wild.
events.backstory: The sickness of the Thistle Pox reached Heaseholm; by 271 the salt-works village was empty.

events.title: Silence at Huduley
events.text: No one will touch the doors of Huduley after the fever, and the walled village slowly returns to the wild.
events.backstory: The sickness of the Thistle Pox reached Huduley; by 271 the walled village was empty.

events.title: The sickness empties Safeiholm
events.text: No one will touch the doors of Safeiholm after the fever, and the charcoal-burners' camp slowly returns to the wild.
events.backstory: The Thistle Pox emptied Safeiholm, and the charcoal-burners' camp was abandoned in 272.

events.title: The sickness empties Haholm
events.text: Whole families die at Haholm, and the few who live join kin at Sidkesk.
events.backstory: Survivors of the Thistle Pox refused to remain at Haholm, and the charcoal-burners' camp was left to the weeds in 272.

events.title: The great flood at Rytel
events.text: The river bursts its banks and drowns the low fields of Rytel.
events.backstory: A warm wind in 274 melted the winter snow in a week, and the Meglibrook filled faster than any dyke could be raised.

events.title: The electors of Svaiyimlal choose
events.text: With no clear heir, the notables of Svaiyimlal vote, and House Nydell wins by a handful of voices.
events.name: The Raising of House Nydell
events.backstory: In 276 a vote at Svaiyimoth ended the rule of Riabrook, and House Nydell has held Svaiyimlal since.

events.title: Hierarch Sieliel of Svaiyimlal
events.text: With the old ruler's seal on a ribbon around the neck, Sieliel of House Nydell becomes Hierarch of Svaiyimlal.

events.title: High water at Sefeathf
events.text: In the night the river changes its bed, taking mills, byres and cellars at Sefeathf, Adehol and Deemelol.
events.backstory: Wind and a spring tide held back the Meglibrook in 280, and the water had to go somewhere.

events.title: The fall of the Oglinon galleries
events.text: A seam gives way at Oglinon, and the rescue crews dig until the lamps run dry.
events.backstory: A spring broke into the deep gallery at Oglinon in 280, and the pumps could not keep pace.

events.title: High water at Bolfekrom
events.text: The river lifts over its banks, and Bolfekrom stand in brown water.
events.name: The Meglibrook Rising of 282
events.backstory: A warm wind in 282 melted the winter snow in a week, and the Meglibrook filled faster than any dyke could be raised.

events.title: Koaton is abandoned
events.text: Koaton is attacked in the dark twice in a year, and the mill hamlet is then left to the owls.

events.title: Sheep replace the folk of Liemieglen
events.text: Sheep are worth more to the lord than tenants, and the walled village at Liemieglen is cleared.

events.title: Symere dies of thirst
events.text: The well at Symere fails in a dry summer, and the mill hamlet is left to the crows.

events.title: Nethorpe given up to the raiders
events.text: Tired of being robbed, the folk of the mill hamlet at Nethorpe walk the road to Ykgoylt and take what they can carry.

events.title: Fieliabrook cleared by its lord
events.text: Sheep are worth more to the lord than tenants, and the hamlet at Fieliabrook is cleared.

events.title: The fall of the Ztecnyt galleries
events.text: The deep workings at Ztecnyt come down on the night shift.
events.backstory: The pit props at Ztecnyt had not been replaced in years, and in 288 the roof gave way without warning.

events.title: The great flood at Rynitid
events.text: The river lifts over its banks, and Schilhyghyl and Rynitid stand in brown water.
events.backstory: A warm wind in 289 melted the winter snow in a week, and the Meglibrook filled faster than any dyke could be raised.

events.title: A vote at Svaiyimoth
events.text: The ring of the elders is passed to House Rythaethorn, and Svaiyimlal has a new ruling family.
events.name: The Raising of House Rythaethorn
events.backstory: Nydell ruled until 292, when the assembly of Svaiyimlal gave the office to House Rythaethorn.

events.title: Hierarch Thysil of Svaiyimlal
events.text: With the old ruler's seal on a ribbon around the neck, Thysil of House Rythaethorn becomes Hierarch of Svaiyimlal.
